title: 第18章 尤来亚这个疯子对上她就快哭了-《同时被N个S级哨兵盯上怎么办》
content:
第(1/3)页

    魏知弦不可能真的对尤来亚示弱。

    且不论他们都是A+级哨兵，实力旗鼓相当。

    他视觉敏锐，早看清黄色越野车后排，还坐着两个人。

    蕾拉，和肖恩。

    肖恩为人还算忠厚，作为副队长，他不会看尤来亚发疯而不加劝阻。

    蕾拉曾经也是魏知弦的学生，这姑娘向来尊师重道，且性格善良，也不会去帮着尤来亚胡闹。

    果然，肖恩已经伸手在猛拍尤来亚的肩膀了。

    “你发什么神经！离颂不在，你找魏知弦麻烦有什么用！你真惹上他，白塔里被他教过的哨兵都要跟我们小队为敌了！”

    “是啊尤来亚！”蕾拉也吓得脸色有些惨白，“魏老师在学院对我们都很照顾，我们这些学生都很爱戴他的，你可千万不要乱来！”

    魏知弦还是低估了尤来亚的疯狂。

    那两句好言相劝并没有让他打消挑事的念头，反而像是火上浇油，激的尤来亚表情都变得狰狞。

    会车那一瞬，两车相距不过三米，尤来亚猛的朝这边打满方向盘！

    轮胎在路面发出刺耳的噪音，车胎甚至都摩擦出了焦糊的气味！

    秦夙余光里，那辆黄色越野车的车头仿佛都被扭曲放大了几倍！

    她本能地抱头俯身，安全带瞬间勒进锁骨！

    要撞车了！

    她惊声尖叫，“救命啊啊啊！！！”

    魏知弦眼疾手快，一键解锁驾驶与副驾的安全带。

    蕾拉花容失色大喊：“魏老师快跳车！！”

    “尤来亚你……”肖恩已经撑开自己的精神力护盾，把蕾拉一起笼罩住，“你真是疯了！”

    “嘭！！！”

    撞上了！

    失去安全带，秦夙被这种巨大的外力冲击，不受控制往魏知弦身上倒过去！

    下一刻就感觉一双有力的大手把她抱进了一副宽阔的胸膛！

    魏知弦抱稳秦夙，赤手空拳，一把就撕开了越野车的车顶！

    车身翻滚的瞬间，他一脚蹬碎座椅靠背，双腿骤然发力！

    几乎贴着撕裂金属的边缘，高高跳起！

    再“嗡——”的一声！

    蓝黑色的精神力瞬间爆发，包裹住两个人，向另一侧安全的区域瞬移了十多米。

    他再灵活的从空中转身，冷目盯着同样从车里瞬移出来的三个人。

    轻盈落地的动作，并不因方才的撞车显出任何的狼狈。

    反而从容优雅。
    第(1/3)页

content_en:
Page (1/3)

It is impossible for Wei Zhixian to really show weakness to Yulaiya.

Regardless of the fact that they are both A+ grade sentinels, their strength is evenly matched.

He had keen vision and had already seen clearly the two people sitting in the back seat of the yellow off-road vehicle.

Layla, and Sean.

Sean is quite loyal. As the vice-captain, he will not let Uriah go crazy without trying to dissuade him.

Leila was also a student of Wei Zhixian. This girl always respected her teachers and had a kind personality, and she would not help Yulaiya do mischief.

Sure enough, Sean had already reached out and slapped Uriah on the shoulder.

"What's wrong with you! If Li Song is not around, what's the use of troubling Wei Zhixian! If you really offend him, all the sentries in the White Tower who have been taught by him will become enemies of our team!"

"Yes, Uriah!" Layla also turned pale with fright, "Teacher Wei takes good care of us in the college. We students love him very much. You must not mess around!"

Wei Zhixian still underestimated Uriah's madness.

Those two kind words of advice did not make him give up the idea of ​​​​provoking trouble. Instead, they seemed to add fuel to the fire, and Uriah's expression became ferocious in anger.

The moment they met, the distance between the two cars was less than three meters, and Yulaiya turned the steering wheel fiercely in this direction!

The tires made a squeaking noise on the road, and the tires even smelled burnt!

In Qin Su’s peripheral vision, the front of the yellow off-road vehicle seemed to be distorted and enlarged several times!

She instinctively held her head and leaned over, and the seat belt instantly cut into her collarbone!

It’s about to crash!

She screamed, "Help!!!"

Wei Zhixian has quick eyes and quick hands, and can unlock the driver's and co-pilot's seat belts with one click.

Leila turned pale and shouted: "Teacher Wei, jump out of the car quickly!!"

"Ulaiya, you..." Sean had opened up his mental shield and enveloped Layla, "You are really crazy!"

“Bang!!!”

Hit by it!

Without his seat belt, Qin Su was hit by this huge external force and fell onto Wei Zhixian uncontrollably!

The next moment she felt a pair of strong hands hugging her into a broad chest!

Wei Zhixian held Qin Su steady and tore off the roof of the off-road vehicle with his bare hands!

The moment the car rolled over, he kicked the seat back to pieces and his legs suddenly exerted force!

Almost touching the edge of the torn metal, jumping high!

Another "buzz--" sound!

The blue-black mental power burst out instantly, wrapping the two people and teleporting more than ten meters to a safe area on the other side.

No matter how nimbly he turned around in the air, he stared coldly at the three people who also teleported out of the car.

The movement of landing lightly did not show any embarrassment due to the crash just now.

On the contrary, it is calm and elegant.
